testimonials.text: The most interesting aspect of the course for me was the management and treatment of wounds. I found it very informative to learn the different types of wounds, appropriate dressing selection and proper techniques to promote faster healing and prevent infection.
The part I found most interesting was the types of wound debridements, it introduced me to many wound debridements I was not familiar with, which was very enlightening.
The speaker and her explaining wound healing so nicely with pictures. It got set in my brain once and for all.

I found the practical aspects most interesting, particularly wound assessment, identification of infection, types of debridement, and understanding the phases of wound healing and different types of wound exudate. The clinical examples made it easy to apply theory to practice.
I found wound assessment, infection prevention, and practical wound management techniques most interesting, especially learning how to promote healing when resources are limited.

I found the explanation of the wound healing phases most interesting, especially how the different cells like neutrophils and macrophages contribute to the healing process. The practical part about wound management and debridement methods was also very helpful.
